# Make the Z matrix

Make the Z matrix

## Usage

``` r
make_Z(d_pmf, N)
```

## Arguments

- d_pmf:

  the density distribution for a probability mass function

- N:

  the maximum MoI

## Value

a [matrix](https://rdrr.io/r/base/matrix.html)

## Examples

``` r
dd = function(x){dpois(x,.2)}
make_Z(dd, 20)
```
